t: This is 55 Tufton Street, a four-storey Georgian-era townhouse in Westminster. Since the 2010s it has hosted a network of libertarian lobby groups and think tanks, linked to pro-Brexit campaigning, climate science denial and fossil-fuel lobbying. Some of them are closely connected with those next door at number 57, which includes the Centre for Policy Studies and CapX. The building is owned by the businessman Richard Smith, which is why his name is attached to it. It's an ordinary-looking front door for a place that has attracted so much political attention.
